data.name: Bolt Riley, A Reggae Adventure
data.detailed_description:
Become a Jamaican Reggae legend in an adventure game co-designed by Corey and Lori Cole (Creators of Quest for Glory series).

Bolt Riley, is a classic 2D point and click adventure game where you play as Bolt Riley, a poor boy from Trenchtown, Jamaica, on his pathway to stardom.

Bolt is struggling to survive and has to deal with a gang of Rude Boys. You go through a journey of self discovery, of love, friendship, and inspiration where you are introduced to Reggae music, you have to form your band, get inspiration, write and produce your songs and then perform them. The story consists of different chapters each focusing on a different aspect of Bolt Riley’s passage into becoming a Reggae legend.

This is the story of the underdog who breaks out and becomes a worldwide sensation.

The game features hand drawn 2D background artwork and hand drawn cel animation. It combines all the elements of a classic point and click adventure game and includes funny dialog puzzles, exploration, wacky inventory items, and of course, a rope. Bolt can use special Inspirational powers he learned during his journeys.
All the music of the game was originally composed especially for it.


Bolt Riley chapter 1 – is only the first installment in the story of Bolt Riley, and only the beginning of a longer story.

Bolt Riley was funded through Kickstarter, and by purchasing Bolt Riley Chapter 1 you help support indie game development and help fund the following chapters.

reviews.review:
Disclaimer: I backed this game on Kickstarter.

When people say this game is unfinished or in a rough shape they are being kind to the game.
The majority of the work put into Bolt Riley is put into an unskippable tutorial that teached you how to play a point-and-click adventure game using [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1220632651][i]hilarious[/i] 4th-wall breaking narration[/url] and explaining [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1220632981]innovative new gameplay[/url]. The jokes range from "Haha that guy is called Smokey because he is always high. Weed is funny" to "Haha, the narrator said commented on the fact that this is a tutorial". There are no other jokes to be found in the game.
Everthing about the game screams "sloppy". Subtitles are slightly different from the voice lines. The voices have not been mastered to sound the same. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1220647510]You can open the inventory in the main menu, and there is no quit option[/url]. The phonebook containing backer names [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1220634230]is not alphabetized and is filled with usernames instead of real names[/url]. The characters keep repeating the same dialogue, even though you have to go through the entirety of a dialogue tree to move on. At one point the game started pestering me stop talkign to a character because there was nothing left to talk about, even though every attempt revealed new dialogue lines. The art has [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1220633415]problems[/url], and is often in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1220634880]much lower resolution that what is needed[/url]. (Why would you decide to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1220634542]zoom in on something of low resolution[/url]? [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1220635209]Twice?[/url]) The music is repetitive and boring, and doesn't even loop well. One would expect for a music themed game to have a musical number of some sort, but that is not to be found in the current game, even though the tutorial takes place just before a gig.
The first episode ends a couple of screens into the game, before the plot has even gotten started yet. This version was released on April 20th 2016 (remember, weed is funny), and not a single update has been published since then, even though the developer [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/331210/discussions/1/364039531220523462/#c364039785154923494]promised episode two on April 20th 2017[/url]. (Weed IS funny, right?)
Instead of working on Bolt Riley the developer has started working on another game: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=863137291]Herbert's Quest[/url], consisting entirely of store-bought or free assets.

This game is not going to be finished. It is not being worked on. It doesn't have any jokes or good music. The art is bad. There is no reason to buy it whatsoever. Stay away and don't waste your money.
